title: Contribution Dispose — payload
description: The keeper's answer to one contribution, by its hash. An addressed answer carries the guide root where the change lives.

contribution.description: The contribution's link hash on the guide's chain, as the keeper's sweep re-derives it.

disposition.description: addressed: the change is in the guide at guideRoot. declined: it will not be taken up. deferred: not yet. keptPrivate: it shapes the guide without being shown.

guideRoot.description: REQUIRED when disposition is addressed: the root of the guide release that carries the change. Absent otherwise.

note.description: OPTIONAL. A short word to the contributor. Never a quotation of the contribution.
